notes.title: Version 1.3 Released!
notes.notes:
We’ve fixed bugs, refined scenes, created additional animations, and even added some underwater interactivity. Nothing especially obvious, just details to polish your experience a bit.

If you have questions, worries, or high fives, send ‘em our way! support@brainandbrain.co

- David & Brooke
